title: Savefile format readers and their common implementation were omitted
reproduction: Compare SOURCE entries with Makefile.in CSRC and the check_headers table in savefile.c.
expected: Supply the local implementations used by the offline reader and writer.
observed: Neither format check function nor their shared linktype/pseudo-header implementation was in the project.
test_evidence: The tracked readers define pcap_check_header and pcap_ng_check_header; sf-pcap.c calls dlt_to_linktype and both readers call swap_pseudo_headers. Project inventory regression passes.

title: WinDump lists predate required checksum and protocol modules
reproduction: Compare each project against LIBNETDISSECT_SRC, CSRC and the INET6 LOCALSRC branch; inspect callers in print-tcp.c and print-udp.c.
expected: Include the implementations for this archived revision and the IPv6 feature all three select.
observed: For example all omitted in_cksum.c, print-mptcp.c, print-ftp.c, print-http.c and print-babel.c; the VC6 project also lacked signature.c and GNU lacked print-rpki-rtr.c.
fix: Add the missing common and enabled IPv6 sources without enabling new optional SDK features.
test_evidence: Regression compares all three lists to the tracked build inputs. Both IDE projects now have 166 units; GNU has 162. Existing Windows version fallback in tcpdump.c means version.c is not required.

title: Projects compiled fallback routines for APIs they declared available
reproduction: Compare HAVE_PCAP_LIST_DATALINKS and name/description feature definitions to missing/datalinks.c and missing/dlnames.c; compare HAVE_BPF_DUMP to bpf_dump.c.
expected: Use the configured WinPcap APIs rather than compiling their local replacements into the executable.
observed: The list stub offers only one datalink; the fallback description is supplied locally as well. Both IDE projects also supplied their own bpf_dump.
fix: Remove these fallback objects from the respective projects; do not change the external dependency or the fallback sources.
test_evidence: Compared the configure.in missing-function selection and public API declarations. All three post-fix inventories exclude the redundant providers.

title: Project input and include names did not match the tracked tree
reproduction: Resolve local input and include paths relative to each project against exact git ls-files spellings.
expected: Use the archive's own path spellings and distinguish external directories.
observed: Case differed for pcap-win32.c, tcpdump.c, the ethernet helper and local include roots. WinDump also named a nonexistent local linux-Include directory.
fix: Correct local spellings and drop the absent local search root; retain the separate WinPcap/common/DAG paths.
test_evidence: All 24/162/166/166 project source paths resolve exactly, with no duplicate object basenames. Case differences alone are not claimed to fail on default Windows filesystems.

title: Generated scanner requests a Unix header in the MSVC project
reproduction: Inspect the tracked scanner.c around its unistd.h include and compare the Visual Studio compiler settings.
expected: Select the generated scanner's non-POSIX header path on MSVC.
observed: The scanner includes unistd.h unless YY_NO_UNISTD_H is set; YY_NEVER_INTERACTIVE does not guard that include.
test_evidence: Checked the file-level DSP definition, scanner's header guard and its WIN32 pcap-stdinc.h branch. No assertion that the old scanner otherwise compiles on a particular SDK.

title: Release compiles ether_ntohost.c without its required definition
reproduction: Read the #error guard in win32/src/ether_ntohost.c and compare both VC configurations.
expected: Both configurations compiling the helper must set USE_ETHER_NTOHOST.
observed: Only Debug set it; Release selected the file but triggered its explicit error.
fix: Add the required definition to Release as in the VC6 project.
test_evidence: XML check confirms the macro in Release|Win32 and Debug|Win32.

title: Visual Studio projects named the legacy socket library for Winsock 2 calls
reproduction: Follow the enabled WIN32+INET6 path in addrtoname.c and the winsock2.h/ws2tcpip.h includes in tcpdump-stdinc.h; compare GNU LIBS.
expected: Request the Winsock 2 import library for the application's getnameinfo call.
observed: MSVC listed only wsock32.lib as its socket library; GNU already used -lws2_32.
fix: Use ws2_32.lib for both MSVC configurations, retaining wpcap.lib and its vendor-specific paths.
test_evidence: Checked both DSP link lines and both XML linker definitions; this verifies the declared inputs, not SDK exports or a linked binary.

title: Install could not build its executable prerequisite
reproduction: From win32/prj run make -Bn install (dry run).
expected: Plan object compilation and windump.exe linking before the install copy.
observed: Before repair make stopped: No rule to make target 'windump.exe', needed by 'install'. The link recipe belonged to main.
fix: Make main depend on the real executable target and link to $@; mark command targets phony.
test_evidence: The dedicated test dry-runs the graph and verifies the link precedes the copy. No executable or installation was produced.

title: Generated comments misidentified probe subjects and format macros
reproduction: Compare both template comments with the compile probes in their local aclocal.m4 and the resulting configure definitions.
expected: Describe the probed member/type and the macro actually being defined.
observed: The HP-UX member was misnamed, struct addrinfo was called a function, and the PRIu64/PRIx64 comments were exchanged.
fix: Correct the checked-in template comments only.
test_evidence: Compared dl_hp_ppa_info_t.dl_module_id_1, struct addrinfo a, and the u/x fallback suffixes; reconciled all 114 and 126 #undef slots. Regenerating from unchanged macro descriptions could undo the comment corrections.

title: Duplicate primary source and non-shipped documentation input
reproduction: Inspect Source entries, %doc, Makefile.in releasetar inputs and configure outputs.
expected: Identify one primary archive and document only files present in it.
observed: Both unnumbered Source entries identified source zero; packaging/pcap.spec is neither tracked nor produced/shipped by the local release recipe.
fix: Keep one Source0 matching libpcap-VERSION.tar.gz and remove the unavailable doc operand.
test_evidence: All eight remaining docs are tracked and in EXTRA_DIST. Version substitution is external to local configure. No release tar or RPM was downloaded.

title: Package omitted build generators and the matching runtime requirement
reproduction: Follow release archive inputs to the grammar.c/scanner.c rules, then trace the installed libpcap.so symlink across subpackages.
expected: Request a lexer/parser pair at build time; installing devel should bring in its versioned shared library.
observed: The release list ships scanner.l and grammar.y, not their generated C; no BuildRequires named generators. The unversioned linker symlink and its target were packaged separately with no declared runtime dependency.
fix: Declare flex and bison for package builds and an equal-version/release libpcap requirement for devel.
test_evidence: configure.in selects the lexer/parser pair; install-shared-so creates the versioned library and two symlinks. Statically checked public headers, manual sections and library glob coverage. RPM resolution was not executed.

title: Unrequested environment and library-path flags leaked into query results
reproduction: Substitute inert include/lib paths and LIBS; request --static --cflags --additional-libs. Repeat --libs and --static with RPATH and show_additional_libs preset.
expected: Only requested flag groups should appear, independently of those ambient variables.
observed: Adding --cflags to --static --additional-libs introduced -L for libpcap itself. Inherited RPATH could enter --libs and inherited show_additional_libs made --static alone emit dependencies.
fix: Initialize both variables and make combined dependency output agree with the standalone flags.
test_evidence: Before/after shell substitution reproduced all three cases. Regression checks 36 shared/static/system/custom and combined-option cases, retaining genuine dependency -L/-l flags.

title: Manual misrepresented combinations and dependency/link-mode flags
reproduction: Compare the synopsis and the --libs/--additional-libs descriptions with inert substituted shell output.
expected: Document independent cflags, shared vs static dependencies and the distinction between reporting flags and selecting an archive.
observed: The synopsis made cflags exclusive with linker queries and the prose suggested default output always listed dependency libraries.
fix: Show valid combinations, explain run paths and static-only dependencies, and clarify that --static does not force archive selection. Preserve the historical manual date in parseable form.
test_evidence: Shell flag matrix and mandoc -Tlint pass; pcap.3pcap is an actual generated/installed manual, not an external tool.
